#### List:

1. Trachea and rings
2. True vocal folds (glottis)
3. False vocal folds = ventricular folds
4. Laryngeal ventricle
5. Anterior commissure
6. Epiglottis
7. Posterior commissure
8. Arytenoids
9. Corniculate tubercle
10. Cuneiform tubercle
11. Quadrangular membrane
12. Aryepiglottic fold
13. Median glossoepiglottic ligament
14. Base of tongue
15. Piriform fossa
16. Oesophagus
